description.en: CriticalSCM-Bench v1 is a synthetic supply-chain benchmark with causal ground truth, paired factual/counterfactual rollouts, and an explicit net-value objective. It evaluates intervention ranking policies across semiconductor, critical-material, and digital-infrastructure archetypes under partial and delayed information, with stress tests on fidelity, timing, cost, and held-out disruptions.
